query:
-- Delete leadActivities for duplicate leads (those with higher id than the oldest per email)
DELETE la FROM leadActivities la
INNER JOIN leads l1 ON la.leadId = l1.id
INNER JOIN leads l2 ON LOWER(l1.email) = LOWER(l2.email) AND l1.id > l2.id;

-- Now delete the duplicate leads
DELETE l1 FROM leads l1
INNER JOIN leads l2
  ON LOWER(l1.email) = LOWER(l2.email)
  AND l1.id > l2.id;
